package.name: xbox_one_s_teleop
package.description: Xbox One S Wireless Controller (Model 1708) Bluetooth teleop for CHAMP: locomotion /cmd_vel (vx, vy, yaw) and a toggleable body-pose mode (roll, pitch) plus a reset-to-level button. Axis/button indices and speed/angle limits are parameters (yaml); nothing robot-specific is hardcoded.
